subject: advanced-maths
title: Advanced Maths — First Partial (Midterm 1)
note: Two problems of 5 points, as in the 2019 and 2020 first partials: one on first- and second-order ODEs and one on a linear system with its phase portrait (always present in the papers). Durations printed on the papers: 1 hour (2019, 2020) and 1.5 hours (2021); 60 minutes is the standard here, 45 and 90 are options.

provenance.structure_source: Read from the text layer of MATHS_FIRSTPARTIAL_2019_MT1/MT2, 2020 (G45, G46, G47), 2021 (G45), 2024 and 2025 (G46, G47) in sources/cuatrimestre-1/04-advanced-maths/examenes/: two or three problems whose marks add up to 10 (4+6, 5+5, 3+4+3). Printed durations: 1 hour (2019, 2020 G46/G47) and 1.5 hours (2021 G45); 2024 and 2025 print none.
provenance.verify_when: The official duration of the current course's Midterm 1 is confirmed; update this file and drop this note.

content_scope_source: Units 1 to 4: modelling, first- and second-order ODEs, linear systems and their phase portraits.

parts.label: Problem 1 — ODEs
parts.description: One problem of 5 points on first-order modelling or qualitative analysis, or on second-order linear equations (reduction of order, constant coefficients, forcing).

parts.label: Problem 2 — Linear system
parts.description: One problem of 5 points on a linear system: eigen-data, general solution, classification of the origin and phase portrait. Always present in the Midterm 1 papers.
